note: What a server sends to say how many uses one of a unit's spells has left and when the next returns.

fields.name: summonerSpell
fields.note: Whether the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own.

fields.name: mostCharges
fields.note: How many uses it holds at most. It is -1 in everything observed, and what that value stands for is not recorded here.

fields.name: rechargeFor
fields.note: How long the next use has been coming back, in seconds.

fields.name: rechargeTime
fields.note: How long a use takes to come back, in seconds.
